fields.what_it_is: The Reline Cervical system is intended to provide immobilization and stabilization of spinal segments as an adjunct to fusion. It includes a variety of screw types (multiaxial screw, favored angle screw, partially threaded favored angle screw, large diameter multiaxial screw, medial lateral favored angle large diameter screw, cortical cancellous large diameter multiaxial screw) with friction fit, color-coded shanks and tulip heads, accepting 3.5 and 4 mm rod diameters, and possessing a C-star 15 drive feature. Laminar hooks are offered as an optional fixation method. The system offers multiple rod types, diameters (3.5 mm and 4 mm), and materials (titanium and cobalt chrome), including straight, pre-bent, and transition rods. Instruments include gearshift probes (cervical and thoracic, straight and curved), drills with fixed and adjustable guides, taps, drivers (threaded, tapered, stab-n-grab), rod cutters, benders (French bender, pipe bender, in-situ sagittal and coronal benders), reduction instruments (reduction tower, Kerrison reducer, rocker, rod pusher), compressors, distractors, and various connectors (lateral offset connectors, cross connectors, extra rod connectors, adjacent segment fixation connectors).

Multiaxial screw: Offered in 3.5, 4 and 4.5 mm diameters; Offered in 10–38 in 2 mm increments and 42, 46 mm lengths; 3.5x8, 40, 44 and 48 mm available upon request.
Favored angle screw: Offered in 3.5 and 4 mm diameters; Offered in 10–38 in 2 mm increments and 42, 46 mm lengths; 3.5x8, 40, 44 and 48 mm available upon request.
Partially threaded favored angle screw: Offered in 3.5 and 4 mm diameter; Offered in 22–46 mm lengths in 2 mm increments; 3.5x48 and 50 mm available upon request.
Large diameter multiaxial screw: Offered in 4.5–7.5 mm diameters in 0.5 mm increments; Offered in lengths of 20–40 mm in 5 mm increments.
Medial lateral favored angle large diameter screw: Offered in 4–5.5 mm diameters in 0.5 mm increments; Offered in lengths of 20–40 mm in 5 mm increments.
Cortical cancellous large diameter multiaxial screw: Offered in 4–5.5 mm diameters in 0.5 mm increments; Offered in lengths of 20–40 mm in 5 mm increments.
Laminar hooks: Come in 6 mm (green) and 8 mm (purple) which refers to the length of the hook shelf.
3.5 mm diameter rods: Straight titanium and cobalt chrome in 120 and 240 mm lengths; Pre-bent titanium and cobalt chrome 25 mm, 30–120 mm lengths in 10 mm increments; Transition titanium in ø3.5–ø5.5 220/265 – ø3.5–4, ø3.5–ø4.5, and ø3.5–ø5 are available upon request (220 mm of small diameter and 265 mm of larger diameter); Transition cobalt chrome in ø3.5–ø5.5 220/265 – ø3.5–ø4 in 485 mm length are available upon request (220 mm of small diameter and 265 mm of larger diameter) – ø3.5–ø4.5 and ø5 in 700 mm length are available upon request (200 mm of small diameter and 500 mm larger diameter).
4 mm diameter rods: Straight titanium in 120 and 240 mm lengths; Straight cobalt chrome in 240 and 500 mm lengths are available upon request; Pre-bent titanium 25, and 30–120 mm lengths in 10 mm increments; Transition titanium in ø4–ø5.5 mm (220 mm of small diameter and 265 mm of larger diameter) – ø4–ø4.5, ø4–ø5, and ø4–ø6 in 700 mm length are available upon request (200 mm of small diameter and 500 mm of larger diameter); Transition cobalt chrome in ø4–ø4.5, ø4–ø5, and ø4–ø6 in 700 mm length are available upon request (200 mm of small diameter and 500 mm of larger diameter).
Titanium rods are color coded to indicate diameter and material type for ease of identification. The Reline Cervical rods possess length markings and a longitudinal line to conveniently identify the proper cut location and bend orientation. The length markings are indicated every 10 mm with vertical dashes. Every 50 mm are indicated with a circle. Cobalt chrome rods do not possess a longitudinal line. The large diameter of the Reline Cervical transition rods are color coded according to the diameter—4.5 mm (gold), 5 mm (purple), 5.5 mm (dark blue) and 6 mm (teal).
Rod selection and markings: 3.5 mm, titanium Dark blue with silver markings; 4 mm, titanium Teal with purple markings; 3.5 and 4, cobalt chrome No color, bare metal.
Tap sizes and descriptions: Single lead taps (one colored band) – 3 mm tap, orange; 3.5 mm tap, purple; 4 mm tap, bronze; 4.5 mm tap, green. Dual lead thoracic taps (two colored bands) – 4.5 mm dual lead tap, green; 5 mm dual lead tap, light blue; 5.5 mm dual lead tap, gold; 6 mm dual lead tap, teal; 6.5 mm dual lead tap, purple; 7 mm dual lead tap, seafoam green; 7.5 mm dual lead tap, blue. The threads on the taps are 15 mm in length. To help gauge depth, the taps are marked gold from tip to 15 mm and laser marked with solid black bands at 15, 20–30, 40–50, 55 and 60 mm, and silver bands at 25 and 45 mm where applicable. Taps are color coded by diameter and match the shank of the same diameter screw.
Gearshift probes: Cervical gearshift probes are 1.6 mm wide at the distal tip and square in shape. When turned 90° in either direction they will produce a ø2.25 mm hole. The cervical probes are marked gold from the tip to 15 mm. Laser marked bands indicate 15, 20–30, 35, and 40 mm of depth with a silver band at 25 mm. Thoracic gearshift probe is 2.1 mm wide at the distal tip and is square in shape. If turned more than 90° in either direction while making the hole, the instrument will produce a ø3 mm hole. The thoracic probes are marked gold from the tip to 15 mm. Laser marked bands indicate 15, 20–30, 35, 40–50, 55 and 60 mm of depth with silver bands at 25 and 45 mm.
Drill: The drill bit is 2.25 mm in diameter. Fixed drill guide features pre-determined depths for the most common screw sizes: 12, 14 and 16 mm. The length of the fixed drill guide is marked on the proximal end of the instrument. Colored bands and handles are the same color as the tulip for screws of matching length. Adjustable drill guide features a range of depths for sequential drilling. Depth is indicated by the laser marked numbered slots. The adjustable drill guide ranges are 8–22, 24–40 and 42–50 mm. The 42–50 mm adjustable drill guide can be special ordered.
Open and closed lateral offset connectors come in lengths of 11, 18 and 25 mm, which are color-coded green, purple and light blue, respectively. The acute-angle lateral offset connector comes in a 25 mm length with a 45º angle from the tulip head. The offset connectors accept both a 3.5 and 4 mm rod. The rod end of the lateral offset connector is 4 mm.
Adjustable tulip-to-tulip connector comes in two sizes—small (25–35 mm) or medium (35–45 mm). The rod portion of the connectors are colored green and purple, respectively.
Static cross connectors come in 28–46 mm widths in 2 mm increments.
Tall lock screw connector comes in small (25–35 mm) and medium (35–45 mm).
Adjustable rod-to-rod connector: The single-pivot design offers two sizes: small with 30–35 mm of translation and medium with 35–45 mm of translation.
fields.indications: The Reline Cervical system is intended to provide immobilization and stabilization of spinal segments as an adjunct to fusion for the following acute and chronic instabilities of the craniocervical junction, the cervical spine (C1–C7), and the thoracic spine (T1–T3): traumatic spinal fractures and/or traumatic dislocations; instability or deformity; failed previous fusions (e.g., pseudoarthrosis); tumors involving the cervical spine; and degenerative disease, including intractable radiculopathy and/or myelopathy, neck and/or arm pain of discogenic origin as confirmed by radiographic studies and degenerative disease of the facets with instability. The Reline Cervical system is also intended to restore the integrity of the spinal column even in the absence of fusion for a limited time period in patients with advanced stage tumors involving the cervical spine in whom life expectancy is of insufficient duration to permit achievement of fusion.
fields.compatible_with: In order to achieve additional levels of fixation, the Reline Cervical system may be connected to the NuVasive Spherx spinal system, Precept spinal system, Armada spinal system, Reline system and Reline 4.5–5 system via the rod-to-rod connectors or transition rods.
